name: Tuwarmon
main_effect:
＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.)
＜Collision＞ (During this Digimon's attack, all of your opponent's Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞, and must block if possible.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By trashing any 1 digivolution card of your [Bagra Army] trait Digimon, 1 of your [Bagra Army] trait Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.) until your opponent's turn ends.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
source_effect: When effects trash this card from a [Bagra Army] trait Digimon's digivolution cards, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
